evidence.observation: Exhaust O2 starts rising from the ~2-6 ppm purged baseline seen through the ramp.
O2 has climbed steadily to 33.2 ppm (10.7, 17.1, 22.2, 26.2, 33.2) over the growth stage.
Pressure is steady at ~760 Torr, so an exhaust blockage (which would raise pressure) is unlikely.
Ar flow tracks the 100 sccm setpoint, so the MFC is not stuck.
Temperature holds at 750 °C with heater power steady at ~45%. The thermal readings are consistent with each other, so thermocouple drift is not indicated.

args.missing_evidence: A leak-rate or pressure-rise check with flow stopped, or a helium leak test on the tube seals, would confirm a seal leak. No ref distributions were provided to put the O2 rise in context against normal runs.
